text:
alex: heads up — noticed a perf regression on the Llama-variant onboarding run after the HF->internal conversion. p95 latency went from 110ms -> 270ms on 8k context.
priya: ouch. did kernel selector fall back to the generic attention kernel?
alex: yes, selector log shows fallback. snippet:
infra-bot: [kernel-selector] model=llama-x, chosen_kernel=generic_attn, reason=rope_scale_mismatch
mike: rope_scale_mismatch? that usually means the model config had unexpected rotary/rope params.
jess: do we have the original HF config? maybe conversion missed rope_scaling or head_dim fields.
alex: found this in converted metadata (safetensors header was sparse):
```json
{"hidden_size": 12288, "num_heads": 96}
```
no "rotary_emb" or "rope_scaling" keys.
priya: ah. without rope scaling we fall back to a safe kernel that disables optimized rotary kernels -> KV layout differs -> cache blowup and worse batching behavior.
mike: can you paste the profiler flamegraph? curious about KV mem / attention hotspots.
alex: pasted output from perf-job:
```
peak_cpu: 72%
peak_gpu_mem: 13.4GB
kv_cache_mem: 8.9GB  # higher than expected for seq=2048
time_in_generic_attn: 82%
```
jess: kv_cache mem that high for 8k context looks wrong. maybe our conversion script used per-head kv dim = hidden_size instead of hidden_size/num_heads.
alex: exactly — I traced into the conversion: conversion.py line 178 sets kv_dim = cfg.get("kv_dim", cfg["hidden_size"]) when it should be hidden_size/num_heads by default.
priya: nice catch. two fixes: 1) parser default to hidden_size/num_heads and emit a warning if kv_dim not present; 2) fallback kernel can attempt to infer rope scaling from compatible models before disabling optimized kernel.
mike: also add a quick unit test converting a small model and assert presence of rotary keys and kv_dim sanity check.
infra-bot: created issue INF-742: conversion defaults -> use head_dim inference + rope parsing. link: https://redwood.example/INF-742
jess: quick patch idea:
```py
# conversion.py
kv_dim = cfg.get("kv_dim")
if kv_dim is None:
    kv_dim = cfg["hidden_size"] // cfg["num_heads"]
    logger.warn("kv_dim missing in HF config, inferring %d", kv_dim)
```
alex: i'll run that locally. also adding parse of safetensors metadata for rope_scaling: some HF models put rope scaling under "rotary_emb"->"scaling".
priya: for immediate mitigation, can we add a runtime relaxed-matching in kernel selector: if rope_scaling missing, try inferred scaling from model dims and test small input; if attention correctness tests pass, allow optimized kernel.
mike: pragmatic. Add a cheap forward check: run a single-batch deterministic input and compare optimized vs generic output L2 norm < 1e-5.
jess: that'll catch mismatched dtype/quantization too. include that in onboarding smoke.
alex: running tests now. will push conversion patch + onboarding smoke test to a feature branch. expecting reduced p95 back near baseline.
priya: great. also add an eval in Optimize that tracks token-level perf vs quality so we alarm when perf regresses after conversion.
mike: thanks team. small follow-ups: please add changelog note for conversion behavior and update docs for HF config fields we require.
alex: will do. cc @jess for unit test review. :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deploy-checks: conversion-tests passed in CI on feature/rope-parser (6/6), scheduled canary for dedicated infra.
alex: thanks — will monitor canary results and report back in this thread.
